channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Tropical Storm Dolly forms in the Atlantic Ocean
item.description: Tropical Storm Dolly became the fourth named storm of the Atlantic hurricane season on Thursday.

item.title: Massive Nepal-Tibet flood leaves hundreds dead, nearly 1,000 missing
item.description: Two days after flash flooding devastated parts of the Nepal-Tibet border, the death toll has risen to at least 543, with many still unaccounted for.

item.title: Norway's King Harald V, Europe's oldest monarch, dies at 89
item.description: The royal court announced that King Harald V of Norway, Europe's oldest monarch, has passed away at the age of 89.

item.title: Norway's King Harald V dies at 89; son ascends to throne
item.description: King Harald V of Norway has died at age 89, and his son has become the new king.
